title: NSPanel: Panel detail
description: Per-panel internals from the panel's own /metrics (metrics firmware only), plus manager-side status-report values.

panels.title: Internal heap free (min since boot)
panels.description: Internal RAM only (PSRAM excluded): every allocation under 16 KB comes from it.

panels.title: Handler time p95 by handler
panels.description: All handlers run one after another on the esp-mqtt task; a slow one delays everything behind it.

panels.title: Share of MQTT task time by handler
panels.description: Seconds of handler time per second of wall time.

panels.title: Subscribe latency p95 by stage (new subscriptions)
panels.description: queued → subscribe sent, suback → SUBACK received, data → retained value received, total → end to end.

panels.title: Subscribe latency p95 by stage (after reconnect)
MQTT connects, disconnects, publish failures (per hour)
esp_timer callback p95 by callback
panels.description: All esp_timer callbacks share one task with the Wi-Fi driver's timers. status_update publishes over MQTT from here (FIXES_PENDING.md).

panels.title: Time in modem sleep
panels.description: Fraction of time the radio sleeps between beacons (screensaver). Compare with temperature and latency for PR #58.

panels.title: Power-save set failures (per hour)
panels.description: esp_wifi_set_ps() calls that failed when the screensaver switched modem sleep on or off.

panels.title: Serial write per log line
panels.description: Only non-zero while serial echo is on (MQTT down, per PR #60).

panels.title: Internal heap free
panels.description: Internal RAM only (MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT, as the status report's heap_used_pct). Every allocation under 16 KB comes from it; the largest free block is what decides whether one fits.

panels.title: Log queue high-water
panels.description: Highest number of log lines waiting since boot. The queue holds 16 (main.cpp:202); at 16, lines are being dropped.

panels.title: Heap used by pool
panels.description: Used fraction of each heap pool. Internal should match the status report's heap_used_pct; PSRAM is the large, mostly idle pool.

targets.expr: 1 - max by (panel, pool) (nspanel_heap_free_bytes{job="nspanelmanager",role="panel",panel=~"${panel:regex}"}) / max by (panel, pool) (nspanel_heap_size_bytes{job="nspanelmanager",role="panel",panel=~"${panel:regex}"})
